desc:
⚡ WELCOME TO BUILDRUSH! ⚡
Build fast. Edit faster. Rush to the win. 🏆

🧱 BUILD walls, ramps, floors and cones to take the high ground!
✏️ EDIT your builds to outplay your opponents!
🎯 FIGHT in nonstop build battles!

⚔️ 1V1 DUELS: settle it one on one.
🌪️ ZONE WARS: up to 32 players, a moving storm, one winner.
📦 BOX FIGHTS & PRO ZONE WARS: team fights from 1v1 to 4v4.
🔥 FFA: every elimination heals you and reloads your gun.
👑 LATE GAME ARENA: ranked matches. Earn Hype and climb 10 divisions.
🏆 ENDGAME CUPS: daily Solo and Duos tournaments with prizes.
🔨 FREEBUILD: practice with infinite materials.

🎁 Unlock skins, pickaxes, gliders and wraps in the 100-tier Battle Pass and the Item Shop!
📊 Climb the Power Ranking leaderboard!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite BUILDRUSH to support the game!
